packs.name: AWS CloudTrail
packs.description: Reads AWS CloudTrail management events (console sign-ins and API calls) into the ASIX data model and watches for root use, sign-ins without MFA, login guessing, logging switched off, IAM privilege changes, access denied bursts and possible public exposure.

packs.name: Azure Activity Log
packs.description: Reads the Azure Activity Log (administrative operations on subscriptions and resources) into the ASIX data model and watches for role assignments, network security rule changes, diagnostic settings removed, resource group deletion and refused operations.

packs.name: Cisco ASA firewall
packs.description: Reads Cisco ASA syslog (denies, connections, VPN and AAA logins, management logins) into the ASIX data model and watches for login guessing, deny floods and management logins.

packs.name: Fortinet FortiGate firewall
packs.description: Reads FortiGate syslog (forward traffic, administrator logins, IPS detections) into the ASIX data model and watches for admin password guessing, blocked critical attacks and deny floods.

packs.name: Home Linux server
packs.description: SSH and sudo watching for a Linux machine at home: logins from the internet, password logins, guessing of usernames, root attempts, and a few risky commands.

packs.name: Home Mac
packs.description: Catches commands that weaken macOS protections or give a program permanent access: Gatekeeper, SIP, quarantine, LaunchAgents, Keychain and Remote Login.

packs.name: Home router and firewall
packs.description: Watches the router: failed admin logins, wifi password guessing, new UPnP port openings and floods of blocked traffic.

packs.name: Microsoft 365 unified audit log
packs.description: Reads the Microsoft 365 audit log (Exchange, SharePoint and OneDrive, sign-ins) into the ASIX data model and watches for mail forwarding and hiding rules, mailbox forwarding and permissions, mass downloads, anonymous sharing links and login guessing.

packs.name: Microsoft Entra ID
packs.description: Reads Entra ID sign-in logs and audit logs into the ASIX data model and watches for sign-in guessing, risky sign-ins, privileged role assignments, conditional access changes and new application credentials.

packs.name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS firewall
packs.description: Reads PAN-OS TRAFFIC and THREAT syslog into the ASIX data model and watches for critical threats that were not blocked, critical threats and floods of denied connections.
